name: Oblivion Confinement
description: Banishes an enemy within %cast_range% tiles for %duration% turns, stunning it but leaving it invulnerable, and stealing %int_steal:pct%% of its intelligence.

upgrade.summary: Another %int_steal:pct%% is torn away when the target returns.
details: A second %int_steal:pct%% is taken the moment it comes back, reckoned from whatever intelligence it has left.
